scope: 2027-2028 dated diagnostic planning; no forecast of delivery or realised sales

delivery_branches.DELAY: Same batches shifted 3, 6 or 12 calendar months; DELAY6 is the main displayed branch
delivery_branches.NO_NEW: No new aircraft; all existing duties remain in KEEP unless a named reassignment is separately evaluated

quantity_basis: Author ramp sizes 3/4/6/8, not an RW delivery promise; earliest H2 2027 is a case boundary
entry_status: Explicit diagnostic lead time; trained crews and approvals not evidenced
maintenance: 14-day grounding stress per tail after its readiness anniversary, staggered within the batch
reserve: One entered serviceable new aircraft held out; never counted as a working rotation tail. Multi-base reserve relocation remains unknown.
company_N: Observed 2026 company list is context only. Future company entered N = LEGACY_ENTERED(t) + NEW_ENTERED(t); legacy available to project is not set to 28 or 20.
aircraft_type: Future SJ100 modelled only through explicit SSJ100 numerical analogue, no PD8 cost or availability acceptance
calendar: 365/366-day denominator for annual source OD; fixed frequencies; daily activity integrated through delivery, entry, maintenance and four named cautious closed weeks
cautious_closed_weeks: ISO weeks 2,15,28,41, seven days each; diagnostic uniform annual demand lost, no recapture; not inferred from kover publication days
seasonality: Uniform within-year baseline only. Tourism guest profiles do not become OD. Seasonal swap C17 remains separate exact product input.
rotation: Closed same-base cycles, weekly tail block <=70h; 14h daily block and16h elapsed construction envelope,45min turns. Crew duty, airport slots/curfews and transfer connections not accepted.
finance: Active-day exposure of fixed weekly offer, not ticket bookings or full-year extrapolation of a December week
support: Owner passenger rates retained only as historical shadow scenario; actual future grants remain UNKNOWN. Separate flight-cap plus all-economy-fare diagnostic does not award funding.
cash: Net settlement-equivalent timing examples only; actual gross receipts, tax settlement, deposits and funding unknown
selection: Best found final8-12-city-pair network feasible in the constructed resource; smaller pilot only where no final fits; KEEP retained against negative contribution
acceptance: OWNER_CALCULATED; independent review pending; no TEAM_ACCEPTED strategy
